answer: A bond must be split across 5 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Because each timber escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the mirror ledger records every share and the atlas audit publishes the split. Assembling that for 112 aliases means 112 times 5 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
